description: This file declares the InProcessTpm class which provides an interface to interact with an in-process TPM simulator via a TSS2_TCTI_CONTEXT. It includes necessary headers, defines the class with constructor, destructor, and a method to access the TCTI context, and contains documentation about its usage and limitations.

classes.name: InProcessTpm
classes.description: A class that exposes a TSS2_TCTI_CONTEXT for interacting with an in-process TPM simulator.

methods.name: TctiContext
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the TSS2_TCTI_CONTEXT used for TPM communication.
